title.en: Miscellaneous Offences (Public Order and Nuisance) (Prescribed Weapons and Equipment) Notification 2009

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Miscellaneous Offences (Public Order and Nuisance) (Prescribed Weapons and Equipment) Notification 2009 and shall come into operation on 1st September 2009.

2. A transport leg brace is specified for the purposes of section 22A(1) of the Act, except a transport leg brace under the charge and control of the Ministry of Social and Family Development for the sole purpose of use as a restraining device on any resident of the Singapore Boys’ Home or the Singapore Girls’ Home of 12 years of age or older and who is likely to escape if unrestrained, during the escort of such a resident.
[S 527/2012 wef 01/11/2012]
